mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.4% signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises above 0.4% but returns remain positive, or if in other periods FEDFUNDS declines without positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates improving labor market conditions, enhancing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 5% but returns are negative, or if in other periods UNRATE drops without positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly demand growth exceeding 16,600 (current GDPC1 value) signals robust economic activity, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 exceeds 16,600 but returns are negative, or if in other periods demand growth is high without positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 0.4%) and improving labor market (UNRATE < 5.0%) both drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but returns are negative, or if one condition is met without the other and returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the production index (INDPRO) above 104.0 signals stronger supply-side growth, boosting demand and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO exceeds 104 but returns are negative, or if in other periods supply growth is high without positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in the federal funds rate below 0.4% signals further easing, amplifying market optimism and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If in late-cycle expansion FEDFUNDS declines but returns are negative, or if the regime isn't late-cycle but the signal is active.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent improvement in labor market conditions (UNRATE < 5.0%) and rising job openings (PAYEMS > 144,448) both drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but returns are negative, or if one condition is met without the other and returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Both rising quarterly demand (GDPC1 > 16,600) and expanding supply (INDPRO > 104.0) signal robust growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but returns are negative, or if one condition is met without the other and returns are positive.
